parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
altogether[ɔ:ltəgeðər]adv.
If something happens altogether, it happens completely. (hoàn toàn, toàn bộ)
↳ The company stopped using sugar altogether in its food.
💡
bind[baind]v.
To bind is to bring people together. (liên kết, gắn kết)
↳ The victims of the flood were bound by their need to help each other.
💡
bruise[bru:z]n.
A bruise is a dark mark caused by being hit by something. (vết bầm tím)
↳ She got a bruise on her knee from falling down.
💡
custom[kʌstəm]n.
A custom is a way of doing things that has been the same for a long time. (phong tục, tập quán)
↳ It is a custom that the bride and groom have the first dance.
💡
disobedient[disəbi:diənt]adj.
When someone is disobedient, they do not follow the rules or instructions. (không vâng lời, ngang bướng)
↳ The disobedient children didn’t listen to their mother and had an accident.
💡
foresee[fɔ:rsi:]v.
To foresee something is to know about it before it happens. (thấy trước, lường trước)
↳ The teacher didn’t foresee any problems with her large class.
💡
glimpse[glimps]v.
To glimpse something is to see it for a short time. (nhìn lướt qua, thoáng thấy)
↳ She glimpsed outside the window as the plane was about to land.
💡
hoop[hu:p]n.
A hoop is a ring that is made of plastic, metal, or wood. (cái vòng)
↳ The boys tried to toss the ball through the basketball hoop.
💡
misfortune[misfɔ:rtʃən]n.
Misfortune is bad luck or an unlucky event. (sự bất hạnh, rủi ro)
↳ His family helped him when he encountered misfortune.
💡
negative[negətiv]adj.
When something is negative, it is unpleasant or sad. (tiêu cực, bi quan)
↳ She doesn’t like to say negative things about her friends.
💡
per[pər]prep.
Per is used to mean “each” when giving a price, size, or amount. (mỗi, cho mỗi)
↳ It costs $8 per person to watch the baseball game.
💡
plead[pli:d]v.
To plead is to ask for something you want very badly. (nài nỉ, van xin)
↳ He pleaded for his parents to let him go to the soccer game.
💡
rip[rip]v.
To rip something means to pull it apart. (xé toạc, xé rách)
↳ She ripped the paper in half by accident.
💡
sake[seik]n.
The sake of something is the reason for doing it. (mục đích, lợi ích)
↳ The parents worked hard for their children’s sake.
💡
scrape[skreip]v.
To scrape something is to rub it very hard with something sharp. (cạo, làm xước)
↳ I accidentally scraped the paint off the side of the car.
💡
source[sɔ:rs]n.
A source of something is the place that it comes from. (nguồn, nguồn gốc)
↳ The river was the source of drinking water for the village.
💡
stern[stə:rn]adj.
When somebody is stern, they are very serious. (nghiêm khắc, lạnh lùng)
↳ The stern teacher didn’t allow the students to speak during class.
💡
stitch[stitʃ]v.
To stitch is to use a needle and thread to join pieces of cloth together. (khâu, may)
↳ My grandmother stitched the pieces together to make a big blanket.
💡
thump[θʌmp]n.
A thump is the sound of a heavy object falling. (tiếng rơi bịch)
↳ They heard the thump when the bowling ball hit the floor.
💡
vehement[vi:əmənt]adj.
When somebody is vehement, they are angry and emotional. (mãnh liệt, dữ dội, kịch liệt)
↳ Gina was vehement when she found out that Liz was bad in school.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: Greg had the _____ of falling in a pool, though he didn’t know how to swim. The experience left him with _____ feelings about swimming pools.
questions.explanation: 'misfortune' (sự bất hạnh) và 'negative' (tiêu cực) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh rơi xuống hồ bơi và cảm giác không tốt sau đó.

questions.content: After one day, the _____ on her lip began to go away. In a week, it had disappeared _____.
questions.explanation: 'bruise' (vết bầm tím) mờ dần, và biến mất 'altogether' (hoàn toàn).

questions.content: For the _____ of fairness, we tried to divide the pizza equally. One pizza was enough to give three slices _____ person.
questions.explanation: 'for the sake of' (vì mục đích/lợi ích của), và 'per person' (mỗi người).

questions.content: A woman _____ with the child to behave in the store. The child, however, continued to be _____.
questions.explanation: 'plead' (van nài, nài nỉ) đứa trẻ ngoan ngoãn, nhưng nó vẫn 'disobedient' (không vâng lời).

questions.content: They walked past a large river, which the guide said was the _____ of a waterfall. They finally _____ the waterfall when they reached the bottom of the hill.
questions.explanation: 'source' (nguồn gốc) của thác nước và 'glimpse' (thoáng thấy) nó.

questions.content: The girl wanted to make her plastic _____ look pretty, so she _____ cloth around it.
questions.explanation: 'hoop' (cái vòng) bằng nhựa và 'stitch' (khâu) vải xung quanh nó.

questions.content: The family was _____ tightly. For example, on Saturdays, it was their _____ to go to the park together.
questions.explanation: 'bound' (gắn kết) chặt chẽ và 'custom' (thói quen, tập quán) đi công viên cùng nhau.

questions.content: The _____ teacher was angry to see the students passing notes. She took the note from the students and _____ it into pieces.
questions.explanation: Giáo viên 'stern' (nghiêm khắc) đã 'rip' (xé rách) tờ giấy.

questions.content: The boy lost his balance and fell with a _____. When he got up, he noticed that he’d _____ his elbow.
questions.explanation: Ngã tạo ra tiếng 'thump' (tiếng rơi bịch) và 'scrape' (làm xước) khuỷu tay.

questions.content: The coach didn’t _____ the loss for his team. So, after the game, he was _____.
questions.explanation: Không 'foresee' (lường trước) thất bại, nên huấn luyện viên trở nên 'vehement' (kịch liệt, giận dữ).

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part A: Match the phrases to make complete sentences.

questions.content: Kelly had the misfortune of breaking _____.
questions.explanation: misfortune of breaking her arm (sự rủi ro bị gãy tay).

questions.content: The disobedient dog ran away _____.
options: to give her a better grade
from its owner at the park
questions.explanation: disobedient dog (con chó không vâng lời) chạy khỏi chủ (from its owner).

questions.content: She felt bound to her friends because she had _____.
options: known them for a long time
questions.explanation: bound to her friends (gắn kết với bạn bè) vì biết họ lâu rồi.

questions.content: The weatherman didn’t foresee any _____.
options: to give her a better grade
questions.explanation: foresee any bad weather (lường trước thời tiết xấu).

questions.content: The family had a custom of _____.
options: gave one piece to his friend
questions.explanation: custom of eating dinner early (thói quen ăn tối sớm).

questions.content: She glimpsed at his painting _____.
options: from its owner at the park
to give her a better grade
questions.explanation: glimpsed at his painting (nhìn lướt qua bức tranh) trước khi nó hoàn thành.

questions.content: Charlie ripped the paper in half and _____.
options: gave one piece to his friend
questions.explanation: ripped the paper in half (xé giấy làm đôi) và đưa một nửa cho bạn.

questions.content: Jasmine pleaded with her teacher _____.
options: to give her a better grade
questions.explanation: pleaded with her teacher (van nài giáo viên) cho điểm cao hơn.

questions.content: Leslie scraped the ice _____.
options: to give her a better grade
questions.explanation: scraped the ice off the window (cạo băng khỏi cửa sổ).

questions.content: George was vehement about being allowed _____.
options: from its owner at the park
gave one piece to his friend
questions.explanation: vehement about being allowed to use the computer (kịch liệt về việc được cho phép dùng máy tính).

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part B: Match the clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: There was a tear in my shirt, _____.
options: so he had bruises on his arm
so my mom stitched it back together
questions.explanation: stitch it back together (khâu nó lại) vì áo bị rách (a tear).

questions.content: She dropped the scissors on the carpet, _____.
options: so there was a slight thump
so he tried jumping through the hoop
questions.explanation: rơi kéo gây ra 'a slight thump' (tiếng động nhỏ).

questions.content: His parents were strict, _____.
options: so he had bruises on his arm
it filled him with negative dreams
questions.explanation: strict (nghiêm khắc) đồng nghĩa với 'stern rules'.

questions.content: The website was good, _____.
options: so there was a slight thump
questions.explanation: trang web tốt nhưng 'sources' (nguồn) không đáng tin.

questions.content: The fight was horrifying, _____.
options: so my mom stitched it back together
it filled him with negative dreams
that was altogether different from mine
questions.explanation: trận đánh kinh hoàng khiến có 'negative dreams' (giấc mơ tiêu cực).

questions.content: I enjoy soda, _____.
options: so he had bruises on his arm
so my mom stitched it back together
questions.explanation: uống soda nhưng chỉ '2 cans per week' (2 lon mỗi tuần).

questions.content: He went to school despite being sick _____.
options: because the sake of his grade depended on it
that was altogether different from mine
so he tried jumping through the hoop
it filled him with negative dreams
questions.explanation: sake of his grade (vì lợi ích điểm số của anh ấy).

questions.content: They used a different system _____.
options: that was altogether different from mine
so he had bruises on his arm
because the sake of his grade depended on it
questions.explanation: different system (hệ thống khác) 'altogether different from mine' (hoàn toàn khác biệt với của tôi).

questions.content: He liked showing off, _____.
options: so he tried jumping through the hoop
it filled him with negative dreams
questions.explanation: showing off (khoe khoang) nên nhảy qua 'hoop' (vòng).

questions.content: He fell down the stairs, _____.
options: so he tried jumping through the hoop
so he had bruises on his arm
that was altogether different from mine
questions.explanation: ngã cầu thang nên có 'bruises' (vết bầm).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Gwen’s New Friends

Gwen walked into the gym for her next class. Coach Peeves said, “Today, we’re playing basketball. The custom is to let you choose your own teams. However, we’re going to do things differently.”

The coach assigned each girl to a team. There were six girls per team. Gwen glimpsed at her teammates. She didn’t know any of them. All of her friends were on the other teams. She couldn’t believe her misfortune.

“I feel sick. May I go to the nurse?” asked Gwen.

The coach could foresee Gwen’s excuses. It wasn’t the first time Gwen tried to leave class. With a stern voice, the coach said, “No.”

Gwen was vehement. “I don’t know any of these girls! Let me play on another team. Please!” she pleaded.

“Gwen, don’t be disobedient. I don’t want to hear any more negative comments from you.”

Gwen had no choice. Then a girl smiled at her. “Hi, I’m Stephanie. I was in your English class last year,” she said. Gwen remembered her. “For the sake of the team, please try your best. I know you’re a good player,” said Stephanie.

When the game started, Gwen played as best as she could. She took a long shot. The ball sailed through the air and went right through the hoop!

“That was awesome!” said one of her teammates. Later, Gwen fell with a loud thump.

“Are you OK?” asked her teammates. They were worried.

She had ripped her jeans. She had scraped her knee and had a small bruise.

Gwen told her teammates, “My knee is fine, and I can stitch my pants later. Let’s keep playing!”

By the end of the game, Gwen forgot altogether that she hadn’t wanted to play, and her team won! The victory bound Gwen’s team together. She had made a lot of new friends, and they were a source of happiness for her for many years.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The custom was to allow the girls to choose their own teams.
questions.explanation: Câu này hoàn toàn chính xác. Huấn luyện viên đã nói rằng tập quán hay thói quen thường lệ là để các học sinh tự chọn đội của mình. Trích đoạn trong bài là: The custom is to let you choose your own teams.

questions.content: Gwen told her teammates that she could stitch her pants later.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Gwen đã trấn an bạn bè rằng mình ổn và có thể tự khâu quần sau trận đấu. Bằng chứng là: Gwen told her teammates, My knee is fine, and I can stitch my pants later.

questions.content: There were eight girls per team.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai nhé. Huấn luyện viên đã chia mỗi đội gồm sáu cô gái chứ không phải tám. Câu văn chứng minh là: There were six girls per team.

questions.content: Gwen pleaded to be on another team that had some of her friends.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Khi thấy đội toàn người lạ, Gwen đã van nài xin được sang đội khác. Bằng chứng là đoạn: I don't know any of these girls! Let me play on another team. Please! she pleaded.

questions.content: Stephanie asked Gwen to lose on purpose for the sake of the team.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Thực tế, Stephanie đã động viên Gwen hãy cố gắng hết sức vì mục tiêu chung của đội. Trong bài có ghi: For the sake of the team, please try your best.

questions.content: Gwen ripped her jeans, scraped her knee, and got a bruise when she fell.
questions.explanation: Câu này hoàn toàn đúng. Sau cú ngã, Gwen bị rách quần, trầy xước đầu gối và có một vết bầm nhỏ. Trích đoạn là: She had ripped her jeans. She had scraped her knee and had a small bruise.

questions.content: Why did Coach Peeves speak to Gwen in a stern voice?
questions.explanation: Huấn luyện viên Peeves dùng giọng nghiêm khắc để cảnh báo Gwen không được ngang bướng và ngừng đưa ra các bình luận tiêu cực. Câu văn chứng minh là: I don't want to hear any more negative comments from you. Nên đáp án B là đúng.

questions.content: How did Gwen know Stephanie?
options: They had an English class together.
questions.explanation: Stephanie đã từng học chung lớp tiếng Anh với Gwen vào năm ngoái. Trích đoạn: Hi, I'm Stephanie. I was in your English class last year. Do đó đáp án D là sự lựa chọn chính xác.

questions.content: What happened after Gwen’s shot went through the hoop?
options: Her teammate said it was awesome.
She forgot about the rules altogether.
questions.explanation: Sau khi quả bóng bay lọt qua vòng lưới, một người đồng đội đã khen ngợi cô ấy. Trong bài viết: The ball sailed through the air and went right through the hoop! That was awesome! said one of her teammates. Vì thế chọn đáp án B.

questions.content: How were the girls on Gwen’s team bound together?
questions.explanation: Chiến thắng trong trận đấu chính là thứ đã kết nối và gắn chặt các cô gái trong đội của Gwen lại với nhau. Câu văn chứng minh: The victory bound Gwen's team together. Do đó đáp án B là hợp lý nhất.
